# reselling_load_balancer_certificate (Resource)

A TLS certificate of a load balancer: `managed` (Let's Encrypt for `domains`, renewed automatically) or `custom` (your PEM certificate and key). There is no update endpoint: every change replaces the certificate. The PEM fields are not returned by the API; after an import they are empty. Import with `load_balancer_id/certificate_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_load_balancer_certificate" "shop" {
  load_balancer_id = reselling_load_balancer.web.id
  type             = "managed" # Let's Encrypt
  domains          = ["shop.example.com", "www.shop.example.com"]
}

resource "reselling_load_balancer_certificate" "custom" {
  load_balancer_id = reselling_load_balancer.web.id
  type             = "custom"
  name             = "legacy"
  certificate      = file("cert.pem")
  private_key      = file("key.pem") # sensitive
  chain            = file("chain.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `type` (String) `managed` or `custom`.

### Optional

- `certificate` (String) PEM certificate (custom).
- `chain` (String) PEM intermediates, issuer of the certificate first (custom).
- `domains` (List of String) Domains of a managed certificate (max. 10); they must point to the load balancer unless their DNS zone is hosted on the platform.
- `name` (String)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Unencrypted PEM private key (custom).

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String)
- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_load_balancer_certificate.shop <load_balancer_id>/<certificate_id>
```
